findings.title: Malformed or incomplete stats response crashes the page and leaves the previous range's data under a permanent 'Loading stats…'
findings.expected: When the stats response is unusable (e.g. an empty object or invalid JSON), the page shows an error such as 'Could not load harvest stats.' and no uncaught error.
findings.actual: An uncaught TypeError "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')" (from stats.plants.length), 'Loading stats…' stays on screen, and the Best plants list and table still show the old 1 Jan-31 Dec 2026 data while From reads 2026-07-01. No error is shown.
